conviction_note: The Q3 headline numbers came out on 6 Nov in a szacunkowe-wyniki release (adj. EBITDA 450m PLN, +48%; the stock rose about 14% over two sessions), and the company gives no guidance. That leaves a November trading update (probably positive, partly priced by the early-November +40% CCC LFL) against a first look at cash flow after a 21% inventory build. So abs_move is 5% (pre-released base, a historically mover-heavy trading update, a weekend window, 51% vol, a disclosed short book) and p_up is 53, close to a coin. The findings sum (+0.4) and the scaled number (+0.3) agree. Most important: the release almost certainly lands AFTER the 27 Nov close, so the sealed bmo window probably contains no release.

findings.finding: Both of Modivo's 2026 full periodic reports carried a sales update from the start of the next quarter, and that update moved the stock (Q1: sales +18% since 1 May, stock +9.5% the next day; H1: +13% for 1 Aug-30 Sep, +2.7%). The early-November run-rate already disclosed is far stronger (CCC LFL >+40%, HalfPrice >+20%), and Black Friday falls inside the period, so a positive November update is the likely new line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 full report (11 Jun, amc) with trading update +18%: +9.51% on 12 Jun. H1 full report (1 Oct, late evening) with +13% update: +2.66% on 2 Oct (MDV.WA daily closes, Yahoo chart).
findings.original_quote: Grupa ocenia, że początek IV kwartału jest bardzo dobry pod względem sprzedaży. (The group judges the start of Q4 to be very good in terms of sales.) Also: LFL in the first days of November rose by more than 40% at CCC and more than 20% at HalfPrice, with Stelmach cautioning against broad conclusions (paraphrase of the article).
findings.why_not_priced: The figures for the first days of November are public, and the stock has run 23% since. What is not public is the whole month to date, including Black Friday. If the market expected a strong November it would already be priced, and the 6-9 Nov +14% partly says that. The residual is whether the full-month number holds near the early-November pace. The CFO's own caution means a slower number is possible.
findings.independence: Q1 precedent, a different document: https://www.parkiet.com/handel-i-konsumpcja/art44613911-modivo-zarobilo-wiecej-niz-sadzil-zarzad-kurs-w-gore. H1 precedent: https://xyz.pl/dzieje-sie/modivo-zwieksza-przychody-poszerza-straty-grupa-dokonala-odpisy-za-557-mln-zl-2405

findings.finding: Group inventory rose 21% y/y to 4.6bn PLN at end-October (off-price purchases +80% to 1.7bn) while store space grew 33%. The full report's cash-flow statement and net debt will be the first look at what that build cost in working capital. The company's plan is to cut inventory by ~1bn PLN by end-2027, not this quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean Modivo precedent was found for a cash-flow surprise. The cross-name lesson is Luceco, which fell 5.5% on negative FCF from an inventory build on a day it raised guidance. In August 2026 Modivo said it wanted to improve cash flow in coming quarters ('chce w kolejnych kw. poprawiać cash flow'), so the line is watched.
findings.original_quote: Prawie 5 mld zł zamrożone w zapasach, sklepy eObuwie jeszcze ze stratą (headline: 'Almost 5bn PLN frozen in inventory, eObuwie stores still loss-making'). The body reports inventory +21% to 4.6bn PLN at end-October.
findings.why_not_priced: The inventory figure is public, and the stock rallied through it on the EBITDA beat and the reduction plan. The operating cash flow and net debt for the quarter are not public. If the market had priced a weak cash quarter, the stock would not have gone into the report at its highest since early March with a 23% run-up.
findings.independence: Company statement of cash-flow intent, a different document: https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20260807/grupa-modivo-chce-w-kolejnych-kw-poprawiac-cash-flow-mocno-stawia-na-price-opis (title only, not read in full)

findings.finding: Modivo carries the largest disclosed short book on the GPW (about 4.12% of capital in 9-13 Nov per comparic snippets), and Parkiet reported on 23 Nov that more funds are shorting it. The shorts sit on a stock up 23% in 20 sessions, so a good November update meets a crowded short rather than a neutral book.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 6 Nov pre-release the stock went +5.25% and then +8.7% the next session. The press framed it as a possible short squeeze ('czy właśnie zaczyna się short squeeze'), but that is a comparic headline only.
findings.original_quote: Coraz więcej funduszy gra na spadek notowań Kruka, Modivo i Grupy Azoty. (More and more funds are betting on a fall in Kruk, Modivo and Grupa Azoty.)
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline has no register reading at all, so this stage's lean ignores the shorts. The level is public in Poland. The asymmetry it creates, covering on good news, is not a level the price can hold in advance. Sized small because a building short is also an informed negative view of the cash line.

findings.finding: On 18 Nov Modivo filed current report 47/2026 on extending a subsidiary's credit financing, after July's 12-month rollover of 2.48bn PLN of working-capital lines. Refinancing risk is cleared before the print rather than a new need.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Stock +5.39% on 18 Nov and +2.45% on 19 Nov. The filing came at 17:07 on the 18th, after the close, so the 19 Nov move is the only one it could have touched. Not attributable to it.
findings.original_quote: MODIVO SA (47/2026) Przedłużenie finansowania kredytowego spółki zależnej Emitenta (extension of the issuer's subsidiary's credit financing)
findings.why_not_priced: Public for a week and routine, so mostly priced. Its only relevance is that the net-debt line in the report sits inside committed, extended facilities, which caps how bad the cash finding can read. Sized near zero.
findings.independence: July rollover of 2.48bn PLN of working-capital lines (raport bieżący 41/2026): https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44795421-modivo-spolka-akcyjna-przedluzenie-okresu-kredytowania-w-ramach-umowy-kredytow-z-12-lipca-2024-r-oraz-przedluzenie-finansowania-kredytowego-spolki-zaleznej-emitenta
